盗.def: to rob, to steal; thief, bandit

origin.says: 㳄 (drooling, craving) over 皿 (vessel): someone drooling over another's dish, hence to steal. The older drooling part is now written 次 (next).

盗.name: robber

ety.hint: A lost 厶 jade 玉

origin.says: A stroke 一 (one) added over 去 (to go away): something gone once and for all, hence to lose or throw away. The top stroke is now slanted.

绑.def: to tie, to fasten, to bind

origin.says: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 邦 (nation) as the sound: to tie up. Simplified from 綁 by the cursive thread 纟.

绑.name: tie up

悉.def: to know, to learn about, to comprehend

origin.says: 釆 (to tell apart) plus 心 (heart, mind): knowing something in detail, fully. Another reading takes 釆 as the sound.

悉.name: know fully

ety.hint: A bamboo ⺮ tablet 扁; 扁 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 扁 (flat) as the sound: a set of bamboo slips of writing, a chapter or article.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus a sound part: to repay. Simplified from 償, whose sound part 賞 (reward) was replaced by 尝 (taste).
Simplified from 紛: 糸 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 分 (divide) as the sound: threads in a tangle, confused, many and scattered. 糸 (silk) is written in its short form 纟.

夺.def: to rob, to snatch, to take by force

ety.hint: A man 大 grasping something 寸

origin.says: Simplified from 奪: a hand (寸, earlier 又) snatching a bird (隹) out of someone's clothing (衣): to seize. The simplified form keeps the hand 寸 and replaces the bird part 奞 with 大 (big).

夺.name: snatch

origin.says: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 冈 (ridge) as the sound: hard metal, steel; the word is related to 刚 (hard). Simplified from 鋼 (金 to 钅, 岡 to 冈).

ety.hint: Many trees 木 forming a forest

origin.says: Three 木 (trees): many trees, a forest; compare 林 (woods) with two.
Simplified from 顏: 彥 (accomplished man) as the sound plus 頁 (head) for the meaning: the forehead, the face, then colour. 彥 became 彦 and 頁 became 页.

棒.def: stick, club; strong, smart; to hit

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 奉 (offer up) as the sound: a wooden club. From "stick" to "hard" to the slang "great, excellent".

棒.name: club

origin.says: Simplified from 盤: 般 (kind) as the sound plus 皿 (dish) for the meaning, 'tray, plate'. The simplified form drops 殳 (tool), keeping only 舟 (boat), itself a reshaped 凡 (tray).
折 (break, decide) as the sound plus 口 (mouth) for the meaning: wise, a wise man. Bronze forms used 心 (heart) instead.

猜.def: to guess, to conjecture, to suppose; to feel

origin.says: 犭 (dog, animal) for the meaning plus 青 (blue-green) as the sound: first to suspect, like a wary animal; now to guess.

猜.name: guess

ety.hint: A woman delivering 乃 a child 子

origin.says: A picture of a pregnant woman with a child 子 (child) inside; the body outline is now written like 乃 (then).

秒.def: a second; a corn kernel; measure word for time

origin.says: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 少 (few) as the sound: first the tiny tip of a grain ear, hence something very small, later a second of time.

秒.name: tick

贷.def: to borrow; to lend; to pardon

origin.says: 代 (replace) as the sound plus 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning: first to give, then to lend or borrow money. Simplified from 貸 with 貝 in its short form.

贷.name: loan

拟.def: to draft, to plan; to intend

origin.says: Simplified from 擬: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 疑 (doubt) as the sound. The simplified form swaps the complex 疑 for the simpler sound part 以 (by means of). Drafting a plan by hand.

拟.name: draft plan

origin.says: Traditional 溝: 氵 (water) plus 冓 (framework) as the sound: a ditch. The simplified form takes the variant 泃, with 勾 (hook) as the sound part.

饮.def: to swallow, to drink; a kind of drink

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms show a person bending over a wine jar with open mouth and tongue out, drinking. Later written 飲, the jar turned into 食 (food) beside 欠 (open-mouthed person); simplified with the short food side form 饣.

饮.name: beverage

origin.says: 代 (replace) as the sound plus 衣 (cloth, clothing) for the meaning: a cloth bag or pouch. A late character, not in the oldest dictionary.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 朁 as the sound: to go under water, to hide. Simplified from 潛, the sound part now written like 替 (replace).

ety.hint: Water 氺 contained by a dam

origin.says: Originally 大 (big) as the sound with 廾 (two hands) and 水 (water): perhaps hands slipping on water. 大 and 廾 fused into the top 𡗗 (fused top, no meaning). Later used for 'great, peaceful'.
彳 (step) for the meaning plus 皮 (skin) as the sound: going over there, that one, the other.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 荅 (small bean) as the sound: a tower or pagoda, a word borrowed with Buddhism from an Indian 'stupa'.

仰.def: raise the head to look; look up to, rely on, admire

ety.hint: To exalt 卬 a person 亻

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 卬 (a standing person and a kneeling one looking up) as the sound: to raise the head and look up, to admire.

仰.name: look up

诞.def: to give birth, to bear children; birth, birthday

origin.says: Simplified from 誕: 言 (speech, now 讠) for the meaning plus 延 (prolong) as the sound; first big, boastful talk, later used for birth.

诞.name: birthday

缩.def: to withdraw, to shrink, to pull back; abbreviation

origin.says: From 縮: 纟 (thread) for the meaning plus 宿 (lodge) as the sound: a cord pulled tight, to shrink, draw back. 糹 became 纟.

缩.name: shrink

ety.hint: Flesh ⺼ used to walk 退; 退 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 退 (step back) as the sound: the leg. It replaced an older character for the same word.

ety.hint: A person bent over 尸 with a towel 巾

origin.says: 刂 (knife) for the meaning plus a shortened 㕞 (to wipe) as the sound: to scrape and scrub clean, then a brush. Another reading takes the left part as a drawing of a brush.

赖.def: to depend on, to rely on; to bilk, to deny; poor

origin.says: 贝 (cowry shell, money) for the meaning plus 剌 (to slash) as the sound: profit, then to rely on; also to deny a debt. The 刂 (knife) of 剌 is squeezed to ⺈ above 贝. Simplified from 賴 by the short 贝.

赖.name: depend

origin.says: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 由 (from) as the sound: the sleeve, the cover one slips the arm into.

缓.def: slow, gradual; to postpone, to delay

origin.says: 纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 爰 as the sound: a loose cord, hence slack, slow. Simplified from 緩 by writing the silk part 糸 in its short form 纟.

缓.name: slack

歉.def: deficient, lacking; to apologize, to regret, to be sorry

origin.says: 兼 (both) as the sound plus 欠 (person with mouth open) for the meaning: first 'still hungry, a poor harvest', hence 'lacking' and then 'to regret, to apologize'.

歉.name: sorry

撤.def: to omit; to remove; to withdraw

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 徹 (remove) shortened to its right side as the sound and sense: to take away by hand, to withdraw.

撤.name: withdraw

循.def: to obey, to follow, to comply with

origin.says: 彳 (step, movement) for the meaning plus 盾 (shield) as the sound: to go along, to follow.

循.name: comply

奥.def: mysterious, obscure, profound; used in transliterations

ety.hint: A person 大 discovering a house 宀 full of rice 米

origin.says: One reading: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus a sound part, 'the hidden south-west corner of a room', hence deep, mysterious; even old commentators doubted that sound part. Another: a rice-offering ritual held in that corner. The inside later became 米 (rice) and the bottom 大 (big).

奥.name: profound

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 具 (tool) as the sound: people together, all.

丈.def: gentleman, man, husband; unit of length equal to 3.3 meters

origin.says: Read as 十 (ten) with 又 (hand): ten hand-lengths, a measure of about three meters; others see a hand holding a measuring staff. It also came to mean a grown man, as in 丈夫 (husband). The strokes now cross, so it stays one piece.

丈.name: ten feet

origin.says: Simplified from 燈: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 登 (climb) as the sound. The new form keeps 火 (fire) and takes 丁 (nail) as a simpler sound part: a lamp.

ety.hint: An older 古 woman 女; 古 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound: an older woman of the family, the father's sister or the husband's mother.
忄 (heart) for the meaning plus 布 (cloth) as the sound: fear in the heart.

吓.def: to scare, to frighten; to threaten, to intimidate

origin.says: Simplified from 嚇: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 赫 (fiery red) as the sound: to shout at, to scare. The sound part was replaced by the simpler 下 (below).

吓.name: scare

origin.says: From the older 荼 (艹 plant + 余 as the sound), the name of a bitter plant. Around the Tang dynasty one stroke was dropped to make 茶, a separate character just for tea.

跨.def: to straddle, to ride; to span, to stretch across

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 夸 (big, boast) as the sound: to take a big step across, to straddle.

跨.name: stride over

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 旦 (dawn) as the sound: level ground, flat; then candid, open.
牛 (ox) for the meaning plus 生 (alive) as the sound, which also fits: a live animal kept for sacrifice, livestock.

衡.def: to measure, to weigh; to consider, to judge

ety.hint: A big 大 horn 角; 行 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 行 (go) as the sound plus 角 (horn) and 大 (big) for the meaning: a crossbar tied to an ox's horns; hence a balance beam, to weigh.

衡.name: balance

origin.says: 囗 (enclosure) for the meaning plus 卷 (to roll up) as the sound: a pen for animals, then a circle or ring.

辞.def: words, speech; to resign, to take leave

origin.says: Simplified from 辭, whose left part showed hands sorting silk threads and whose right part 辛 meant putting in order: setting out an argument, words; later 'to take leave'. The left part is now written 舌 (tongue).

辞.name: resign

宜.def: fitting, proper, right; what one should do

ety.hint: A memorial service 且 held in a house 宀

origin.says: Originally pieces of meat on a sacrificial stand 且 (altar): a fine offering, hence fitting, proper. The enclosing part was later written like 宀 (roof) and the meat dropped.

宜.name: fitting

截.def: to cut off, to obstruct, to stop; segment; intersection

ety.hint: A bird 隹 cut off from its nest 十 by a weapon 戈

origin.says: 戈 (dagger-axe) for the meaning plus 雀 (sparrow) as the sound: to cut off. The 小 (small) of 雀 has shrunk into the 十-like strokes over 隹 (bird).

截.name: chop short

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 冡 (cover) as the sound: plants covering things over, hence to cover, to keep in the dark, to deceive. Also used for Mongolia by sound.
The full form 郵 is 垂 (far border) plus 阝 (from 邑, town): a relay station on the frontier. The simplified form keeps 阝 and swaps in 由 (from) as the sound.
A picture of water flowing between banks: a river or stream.

扎.def: to bind, to wrap; to pierce; to stop

ety.hint: A hand 扌 tying a bundle with string 乚

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 乙 (second), written in its hooked form 乚, as the sound: to pierce, to tie up, to bind.

扎.name: tie bundle

抽.def: to draw out, to pull out; to sprout

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 由 (from) as the sound: to pull something out by hand, to draw out.

抽.name: pull out

origin.says: A hand (top) grabbing an animal's tail (bottom) from behind: to catch, and so a captive who serves. It also stands for 隸 (servant), which adds 柰 as the sound.
子 (child) for the meaning plus 瓜 (melon) as the sound: a child without a father, an orphan, and so alone, lonely.

辩.def: to argue, to dispute; to discuss, to debate

ety.hint: A bitter 辛 exchange of words 讠

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning set between 辡 (two 辛, two culprits) as the sound: two parties accusing each other, to argue. Simplified from 辯 (言 → 讠).

辩.name: argue

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 闰 (extra) as the sound, which also hints at plenty: moist, sleek. Simplified from 潤, with 門 written 门.

杯.def: cup, glass; measure word for liquids

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 不 (not) as the sound: a wooden cup (earlier written 桮).

杯.name: cup

贯.def: to pierce, to string up; a string of 1000 coins

origin.says: 毌 (a string piercing something) plus 贝 (shell, money): shells strung on a cord, a string of coins, to pierce through. One reading sees two shells strung together instead. Simplified from 貫 by writing 貝 as 贝.

贯.name: coin string

插.def: to insert, to stick in; to pierce; to plant

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 臿 (a pestle in a mortar 臼) as the sound and meaning: to thrust in, to insert.

插.name: insert

骂.def: to accuse, to blame, to curse, to scold

origin.says: Originally 罵: 网 (net) for the meaning, as if catching someone in a net of words, plus 馬 (horse) as the sound. The variant 駡 wrote the net as two 口 (mouths), and the modern form keeps that top over 马.

骂.name: scold

颁.def: to bestow, to confer; to publish

ety.hint: To pass out 分 a booklet 页; 分 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 頒: 分 (to divide) as the sound plus 頁 (head) for the meaning; now 'to hand out, bestow'. 頁 is simplified to 页.

颁.name: hand out

origin.says: From 牆: 爿 (a plank) as the sound plus 嗇 (grain stored in a granary) for the meaning, the granary wall. A variant swapped 爿 for 土 (earth), and 嗇 was simplified to 啬.

伸.def: to extend, to stretch out, to open up; to trust

ety.hint: To extend your confidence 申 to another person 亻; 申 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 申 (extend) as the sound and sense: a person stretching out.

伸.name: stretch

origin.says: 冫 (ice), the original picture of the word, plus 水 (water) added later for the meaning: ice.

驶.def: to drive, to pilot, to ride; fast, quick

origin.says: Simplified from 駛: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 史 (history) as the sound: a horse running fast, hence to drive or sail.

驶.name: drive

拔.def: to uproot, to pull out; to select, to promote

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 犮 (a dog dragged by its leg) as the sound: a hand pulling out, to uproot.

拔.name: uproot

戴.def: to support; to respect; to put on, to wear; surname

origin.says: First a picture of a person holding something on the head with both hands (like 異, different); later 異 for the meaning plus 𢦏 (wound) as the sound: to put on, to wear.

戴.name: wear on head

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 爰 as the sound: warmth from the sun.

ety.hint: A woman 女 related by 因 marriage

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 因 (cause) as the sound, which also suggests 'relying on': marriage, in-laws.
